title: Andrew Flintoff Resigns as England Lions Head Coach
summary: Andrew Flintoff has resigned from his position as the head coach of the England Lions cricket team. The specific reasons for his departure were not detailed in the coverage. Flintoff had taken on the role previously.
summary_points: Andrew Flintoff has resigned as head coach of the England Lions.
The coverage did not specify the reasons for his resignation.
Flintoff had previously held the coaching position.
